description: 1818-1831 general-election contests whose pollDate was taken from Walker's printed date. Walker's introduction (p. xii): his dates are official dates of return; before 1818 they record the beginning of an election, from 1818 the day the returning officer signed the writ of return (usually the close and declaration of the poll). The overlay labels these 'Date of return' rather than 'Polling began'. Pre-1818 dates and the History-of-Parliament-dated contests are left as they are. scripts/walker/import_walker_1801_1831.py now writes pollDateKind itself, so a re-import carries the same label.
